clips.title: The story
paras: At Farstrider Lodge, A Hunter's Challenge tests your speed across Loch Modan's rugged highlands. Daryl the Youngling, a brash human, wagers his shirt that you cannot track and kill five elder mountain boars within twelve minutes, against rough ground and dangerous wildlife.

Daryl the Youngling lives among the seasoned huntsmen of Farstrider Lodge, but he has none of their quiet patience. He makes up for his youth with bluster and tall hunting tales, including rambling stories of how he earned his “famous” scar. Unwilling to admit anyone else is skilled, he continually gets his fellow hunters’ names wrong. He also devises strict trials to humble newcomers and restore his inflated standing among the lodge’s residents.

The elder mountain boars that roam Loch Modan’s crags and hillsides are massive, thick-skinned, and dangerous when provoked. Daryl gives you twelve minutes to find five, kill them, and confirm each kill. Finish in time, and the loudmouthed youngster retreats awkwardly, pretending he knows nothing of the extravagant wager he made so casually.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friendath, is it? I can tell you're bursting with pride over completing the first test, hm? As I told you before, it's no large feat.
You should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them. I'll give you just twelve minutes this time.
Don't feel bad if you fail. I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!
Have I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? No? It was two years ago...

clips.title: Progress
paras: It's only natural to feel sorry for yourself when shown up by someone so new to this world. You shouldn't feel bad, friendah.
Hm? Did I get your name wrong?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You seem a bit worse for wear. No doubt the boars gave you some trouble, hm? No worries, I will be discreet about your struggle, I can imagine how hard it must be for you without the accusations of wagging tongues.
Oh! You managed to kill the boars? I... Well, that is... That is to say, I'm not surprised! Any child could have—bet?
